usageNotes: Use this to permanently remove a specific TFA entry (TOTP, WebAuthn, recovery codes, etc.) from a user account. A user can delete their own TFA entries; an admin with User.Modify permission can delete entries for any user. Note that API tokens cannot perform this operation — it requires a full user session (allowtoken: false), and the optional password field is required in some realm configurations as a confirmation safeguard.

examples.summary: Remove a TOTP entry from a local PVE user

destructiveReason: Permanently deletes the specified TFA entry; the user will no longer be challenged by that factor, and the entry cannot be recovered.
tips: This endpoint cannot be called with an API token — authenticate as a full user session.
If the target user has only one TFA entry and the realm enforces MFA, removing it may lock the user out or force re-enrollment on next login.
Obtain the TFA entry id first via the corresponding GET /access/tfa/{userid} listing endpoint.
Admins with User.Modify can act on any user; non-admins are limited to their own account (self).
